quote: High-quality texts are more suited for task-specific supervised data. For example, the abstracts and related work texts can be used as direct references for summarization and related work generation (Hoang and Kan, 2010; Hu and Wan, 2014) tasks, respectively.

For instance, higher-quality full texts better foster the development of document-level information extraction tasks. The structured information in full texts, such as sections and paragraphs, facilitates section-wise tasks such as related work generation (Hoang and Kan, 2010)
outputs: The paper discusses enabling outputs like summaries, captions for figures, and generated related work sections using the structured full texts in the OCL corpus.
